records.text: Candace Owens said Donald Trump does not personally publish his social-media posts and that Natalie Harp is widely reported to handle his Truth Social account
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: There is no way in hell that Donald Trump, who has never, by the way, pushed send on his own tweets, that was the job initially of Dan Scavino during his first term. ... And now it's widely reported that on Truth Social, that's the job of Natalie Harp.

verification.notes: Current reporting confirms Natalie Harp often types and posts Truth Social messages dictated by Trump and that Dan Scavino has also managed or accessed his social accounts. However, officials cited by current reporting say Trump also often posts personally, directly contradicting the absolute claim that he has never pushed send himself.
